useCases.title: A real free LLM API for side projects
useCases.summary: A documented free tier for side projects
useCases.problem: Most “free LLM API” posts dump a list of expired keys. You need no daily cap, a model id that fails over, and a path to pay $2 when you outgrow it.

snippets.code:
curl https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANYROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "anyrouter/free",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence." }]
  }'
